title: Patterns
description: Classification output for a rule source. Contains sink candidates and universal pattern findings, plus optional source-specific context.

sourceFile.description: Path to the ingested source file this classification was produced from.

sourceContext.description: Source-specific classification context not expressible in universal terms (e.g. ruleflow invocation order for Corticon).

sinkCandidates.description: Facts identified as graph outputs — derived facts not referenced by any other derived fact. Keys are fact node identifiers.

patterns.description: Universal pattern findings from the translation-patterns catalog. Both Corticon and rulespec classifiers populate this.

definitionCount.description: Number of rules that write to this fact.

totalDefinitions.description: Total rules in the source, used as the denominator for definitionCount.

latestPosition.description: Latest execution position of any rule writing to this fact. Null if position is unknown.

totalPositions.description: Total execution positions in the source, used as the denominator for latestPosition.

isOutput.description: True if this fact is declared as an explicit output in the source configuration.

pattern.description: Pattern name from the translation-patterns catalog.

variant.description: Sub-type of the pattern, for patterns with type-of relationships in the catalog (e.g. null-guard variants: default, fallback, table; call variants: function, procedure, opaque).

node.description: The fact node this finding applies to, in entity.attribute form.

nodes.description: Ordered list of fact nodes forming a cycle path. Used for multi-hop cycle findings.

ruleId.description: The rule this finding applies to. Format: file.ers:N for a specific rule, file.ers:* for all rules in a rulesheet.

ruleIds.description: Multiple rule identifiers. Used when a finding spans more than one rulesheet (e.g. composition: ['file1.ers:*', 'file2.ers:*']).

expression.description: Source expression text. Used for guard and expression-level pattern findings.

entityType.description: The entity type being constructed. Used for constructor pattern findings.

connector.description: External connector definition. Used for call pattern findings.
